notes: 2028–2030 ownership snapshot checked 2026-09-28. Unresolved conditional assets are reserved, not offered twice.
Future compensation picks are not invented. No 2030 transfers were identified in the checked ledger.

Unknown future slots use the middle of the same round; first rounds receive a 20% uncertainty adjustment. An additional 5% per season beyond the first is a simulator assumption, not an OTC formula. Grades count full future capital.
Positional needs are estimates from the projected contract roster, not reported team boards. Missing specialist contracts receive a neutral 1/3 prior rather than assuming an urgent need.

2027 free-agent guides distinguish attributable published market projections from authored player/role estimates. Most players do not yet have a publicly accessible 2027 AAV projection. These are not current salary multipliers or guaranteed offers.
Listed snap percentages come from the captured OTC free-agent table and are a limited role proxy, not verified 2026 season totals. Simulator ratings are authored; not licensed PFF grades.
All 32 teams use verified 2024–2026 draft pedigree where the original rookie contract still applies. Draft capital, production assessment, age, remaining cash and team reluctance are separate inputs.
Player interest and team willingness vary per new run and represent fictional simulation preferences, not statements by real players or teams.
Future picks through 2030 are tradable throughout the active Premium Offseason. The free Draft Simulator supports current-year selections only.

September 30 draft update: the public NFL Mock Draft Database Consensus Big Board supplies simulator ranks 1–100. Remaining prospects keep Drafttek relative ordering, excluding all Consensus Top 100 players; they are explicitly labeled supplemental. No inaccessible consensus rankings are invented.

The Consensus Mock Draft is a separate source: its public first-round player/team pairings add at most 0.3/3 to the corresponding modeled positional need, weighted by the displayed projection share. This small modeled signal does not force a named player, change pick ownership, or replace roster changes and per-run variation.

October 1: 2027 Jets existing cap charges rechecked against OTC contract rows. $327M league cap remains a projection; signed salaries are preserved. Raw room $87.811M excludes future rollover not yet earned.

Rookie reserve is the actual incremental Top-51 cost of unsigned Jets picks, recalculated after roster moves and pick trades using a projected 2027 slot schedule. The simulator separately reserves minimum salaries to reach 51 when necessary.

2027 compensatory order refreshed from OTC: 32 projected CFA selections plus one JC-2A special selection, none for NYJ. Projections are not official awards. 2027 simulated UFA movement does not change the 2027 comp order.

Genuine: up to 90 offseason players, restricted/ERFA rights, projected reserve/future candidates and post-draft UDFAs. Simplified: 53-player target without those extra phases. Neither mode creates an offseason practice squad.

RFA/ERFA designations are OTC projections. Practice-squad names use the September 28 league snapshot (Jets rechecked October 1). Futures eligibility assumes they remain off active rosters at season end. Experience is not a certified accrued/credited-season ledger; projected minimum offers are labeled.

2027 tender and rookie/UDFA allocations are estimates until the league publishes them. RFA first/second/original tenders include the applicable 110% prior-base floor; ERFA rights belong to the original club.

New contract choices are modeled schedules: Backloaded (default), Balanced, Front-Loaded, Incentive Based. Signing bonus is included in guarantees and prorated; conditional incentives are separate from fixed AAV and cannot replace guarantees.
Genuine timeline compresses RFA matching windows into explicit decisions before advancing. Tender compensation transfers an eligible original 2027 pick, never a future or compensatory pick.

Restructures preserve cash and minimum base and spread converted salary over up to five remaining years. The simulation asks for consent and caps attempts at three; real contracts may already authorize conversion.

UDFA signing bonuses use a modeled $250,000 planning limit pending the official 2027 rookie pool. Guaranteed minimum base is separate. Minimum salaries after 2030 extrapolate the current $45,000 annual increase, pending the next CBA.

October 1 roster reconciliation includes Jason Sanders and Kohl Levao active; Jordan Clark and Blake Grupe practice squad; John Saunders unsigned. Published new active contract terms must be refreshed when available.
Genuine: reserve/futures only in Stage 2 before unrestricted free agency. Signed and available statuses are simulated and vary each run. There is no offseason practice squad.
Genuine rosters above 90 may finish with a warning and grade penalty. Simplified uses a 53-player reference, without a hard roster maximum.
All releases use pre-June 1 acceleration, without a June 1 designation or delayed savings.
Briggs projected 2027 RFA uses official 2024–2025 active history and assumes an accrued 2026 season; OTC currently retains an ERFA label. Accrued and credited seasons differ from listed experience.

Practice-squad candidates are excluded from projected original-club RFA/ERFA rights pools. Morrisey minimum uses two credited seasons, distinct from listed experience. Rookie extensions obey the three-season drafted/two-season undrafted waiting periods.
Cap figures distinguish estimated rollover, raw room, incremental rookie reserve and minimum-roster reserve. No unexplained adjustment is used to match a headline effective-cap figure.
Franchise/transition tags, 2028 fifth-year option salary and 2028 compensatory selections are projections, not finalized NFL awards.
Street free agents have no remaining club rights, generally after release/waivers; fewer than four accrued seasons alone does not establish street eligibility.

Draft QB outlooks are simulated scenarios anchored to current roster, age, contract commitment and investment. MDDB remains the primary ranking and mock-fit baseline. Alternative mocks calibrate variation, not a replacement board.

Draft declarations vary once per run for 15 reviewed players with remaining eligibility. Probabilities are simulation settings, not reported decisions; absent prospects cannot be drafted or recruited as UDFAs. Other prospects remain in the sourced pool.
futurePickNotes: 2028–2030 ownership snapshot checked 2026-09-28. Unresolved conditional assets are reserved, not offered twice.

Unknown future slots use the middle of the same round; first rounds receive a 20% uncertainty adjustment. An additional 5% per season beyond the first is a simulator assumption, not an OTC formula. Grades count full future capital.
Future compensation picks are not invented. No 2030 transfers were identified in the checked ledger.
Future picks can be traded throughout the active Premium Offseason. Free Draft receives current-year picks only.

salaryRules.udfaPoolStatus: Modeled $250,000 planning limit, not a published 2027 league allocation. The CBA ties the actual limit to growth of the Total Rookie Compensation Pool; replace this forecast when published.
salaryRules.tagStatus: Projected, not official 2027 amounts. Exclusive tags use a modeled current top-five salary average with the non-exclusive amount as a floor. Prior-year salary uses reported data where present, otherwise current contract APY as an explicitly labeled proxy.

capAudit.explanation: Projected 2027 league cap $327.000M (OTC), plus $10.422147M estimated rollover (Spotrac), less $228.149986M signed contracts and $10.039005M dead/void charges = $99.233156M raw cap room. Reserving $29.644160M incremental rookie charges and $2.790M for three additional minimum contracts leaves $66.798996M. Rollover is an October forecast, not a confirmed season-end amount. Spotrac’s $101.180157M is raw room and expressly excludes its draft placeholders; its base cap is $323M. OTC’s $102.516955M effective display remains unreconciled with its contract ledger.
capAudit.rosterAdjustment: Remove waived Jordan Clark 2027 non-guaranteed base; no unreported Levao/Sanders 2027 commitment invented.
capAudit.reconciliation: Compared with Spotrac: OTC league cap +$4M; Onyemata accelerated void charge costs $4.5M more; Heflin/McClain commitments cost $2.17M more; McDonald option costs $0.723M less; Mason Taylor rounding costs $1 more. Net raw room is $1.947001M lower. The rookie and minimum-roster reserves are then separate deductions, not missing cap space.
